# Porsche Design System: Complete Machine Reference & Prompt Bundle (Version 4.5.0 / Trainable DS v1.7.0)

> This document is the full, exhaustive reference for the Porsche Design System extracted live from porsche.de. You can inject this entire file into any AI agent system prompt to achieve 100% compliant Porsche UI generation.

---

## 1. System Foundations & Visual Philosophy

### 1.1 Porsche Semantic Color Taxonomy (Dual Scheme via light-dark())

#### Canvas & Surface
- `--p-color-canvas`: Base page background.
  - Light Mode: `#ffffff`
  - Dark Mode: `#010205`
- `--p-color-surface`: Secondary container background.
  - Light Mode: `#f1f1f4`
  - Dark Mode: `#19191a`

#### Primary Brand Action
- `--p-color-primary`: High-emphasis actions, active states, and titles.
  - Light Mode: `#010205` (Tone 10)
  - Dark Mode: `#fafbff` (Tone 98)
- `--p-color-on-primary`: Text and iconography placed atop primary background.
  - Light Mode: `#ffffff`
  - Dark Mode: `#010205`

#### Frosted Glass Material System (Elevation without Heavy Shadows)
- `--p-color-frosted-soft`:
  - Light Mode: `rgba(143, 145, 163, 0.06)`
  - Dark Mode: `rgba(65, 65, 70, 0.154)`
- `--p-color-frosted`:
  - Light Mode: `hsla(240, 5%, 70%, 0.148)`
  - Dark Mode: `hsla(240, 2%, 43%, 0.228)`
- `--p-color-frosted-strong`:
  - Light Mode: `rgba(100, 101, 114, 0.236)`
  - Dark Mode: `rgba(156, 156, 159, 0.302)`
- Backdrop Filter Blur: `blur(32px)` applied concurrently with frosted fills.
- Scrim Backdrop: `--p-color-backdrop`: `rgba(36, 36, 40, 0.5)`

#### Contrast Hierarchy (Readable Content Layers)
- `--p-color-contrast-higher`:
  - Light: `rgba(21, 21, 25, 0.8)` | Dark: `rgba(246, 246, 248, 0.78)`
- `--p-color-contrast-high`:
  - Light: `rgba(26, 26, 30, 0.7)` | Dark: `rgba(246, 246, 248, 0.67)`
- `--p-color-contrast-medium`:
  - Light: `rgba(17, 17, 19, 0.6)` | Dark: `rgba(246, 246, 248, 0.56)`
- `--p-color-contrast-low`:
  - Light: `rgba(36, 36, 40, 0.5)` | Dark: `rgba(246, 246, 248, 0.45)`
- `--p-color-contrast-lower`:
  - Light: `rgba(79, 80, 89, 0.324)` | Dark: `rgba(156, 156, 159, 0.302)`

#### Semantic Feedback Roles
- `--p-color-focus`: `#1a44ea` (2px solid outline with 2px offset)
- `--p-color-info`: Light `#1a44ea` / Dark `#178bff`
- `--p-color-success`: Light `#197e10` / Dark `#10c47f`
- `--p-color-warning`: Light `#ac5102` / Dark `#f4882a`
- `--p-color-error`: Light `#ba171f` / Dark `#fc4040`

---

### 1.2 Fluid Responsive Typography Scale

Font Family: `"Porsche Next", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif`
Line Height: `calc(6px + 2.125ex)`

| Scale Tier | Mathematical Expression | Weight | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `5xl` | `clamp(2.28rem, 5.2vw + 1.24rem, 7.48rem)` | 700 Bold | Massive showcase stage splash |
| `4xl` | `clamp(2.03rem, 3.58vw + 1.31rem, 5.61rem)` | 700 Bold | Hero display title |
| `3xl` | `clamp(1.8rem, 2.41vw + 1.32rem, 4.21rem)` | 600 Semibold | Screen primary headline |
| `2xl` | `clamp(1.6rem, 1.56vw + 1.29rem, 3.16rem)` | 600 Semibold | Section title |
| `xl`  | `clamp(1.42rem, 0.94vw + 1.23rem, 2.37rem)` | 600 Semibold | Subsection title |
| `lg`  | `clamp(1.27rem, 0.51vw + 1.16rem, 1.78rem)` | 600 Semibold | Component / card title |
| `md`  | `clamp(1.13rem, 0.21vw + 1.08rem, 1.33rem)` | 600 Semibold | Subheadings & lead copy |
| `sm`  | `1rem` (16px) | 400 Regular | Default body copy |
| `xs`  | `0.875rem` (14px) | 400 Regular | Supporting copy, form labels |
| `2xs` | `0.75rem` (12px) | 400 Regular | Legal notices, consumption data |

*Rule:* All button labels, headings, and navigational links MUST use sentence case (`Book appointment`, not `Book Appointment`).

---

### 1.3 Spacing & Layout Rhythm

#### Static Spacing
- `2xs`: 1px
- `xs`: 4px
- `sm`: 8px
- `md`: 16px
- `lg`: 32px
- `xl`: 48px
- `2xl`: 80px

#### Fluid Spacing
- `fluid-xs`: `clamp(4px, 0.25vw + 3px, 8px)`
- `fluid-sm`: `clamp(8px, 0.5vw + 6px, 16px)`
- `fluid-md`: `clamp(16px, 1.25vw + 12px, 36px)`
- `fluid-lg`: `clamp(32px, 2.75vw + 23px, 76px)`
- `fluid-xl`: `clamp(48px, 3vw + 38px, 96px)`
- `fluid-2xl`: `clamp(80px, 7.5vw + 56px, 200px)`

#### Border Radii
- `xs`: 2px
- `sm`: 4px
- `md`: 6px
- `lg`: 8px
- `xl`: 12px (Standard card & button radius)
- `2xl`: 16px
- `3xl`: 24px
- `4xl`: 32px
- `full`: 9999px (Pill buttons & round badges)

#### Elevation Shadows & Motion
- Shadows:
  - `sm`: `0px 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)`
  - `md`: `0px 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)`
  - `lg`: `0px 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)`
- Motion Durations:
  - `duration-sm`: 0.25s
  - `duration-md`: 0.4s
  - `duration-lg`: 0.6s
  - `duration-xl`: 1.2s
- Easing:
  - `base`: `cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)`
  - `in`: `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)`
  - `out`: `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.5, 1)`

---

## 2. Certified Component Contracts (Across 7 Functional Families)

### 1. Actions Family
- `<p-button variant="primary | secondary" compact="true | false" loading="true | false" icon="...">`:
  - Container: min 48x48px touch target.
  - Primary: `bg: var(--p-color-primary)`, `color: #fff`.
  - Secondary: `bg: var(--p-color-frosted-strong)`, `color: var(--p-color-primary)`.
  - Example: `<p-button variant="primary">Configure your 911</p-button>`
- `<p-button-pure icon="..." underline="true | false">`:
  - Text-only button with animated underline.
  - Example: `<p-button-pure icon="arrow-right">Technical details</p-button-pure>`

### 2. Navigation Family
- `<p-link href="..." variant="primary | secondary">`: High-contrast route link.
- `<p-link-pure href="..." icon="arrow-right">`: Inline content navigation.
- `<p-link-tile href="..." label="..." description="..." aspect-ratio="16:9">`:
  - Visual hero card with image slot and frosted overlay.
  - Example:
    ```html
    <p-link-tile href="/models/cayenne" label="Cayenne Electric" description="Electrifying versatility">
      <img src="/cayenne.jpg" alt="Porsche Cayenne" />
    </p-link-tile>
    ```
- `<p-tabs active-tab-index="0">`: Accessible tabs container.
- `<p-pagination total-items-count="120" items-per-page="12" active-page="1">`: Paging control.

### 3. Typography Family
- `<p-display tag="h1 | h2" size="small | medium | large">`: Stage hero headlines.
- `<p-heading tag="h2 | h3" size="small | medium | large | xl | 2xl" weight="semibold">`: Section headers.
- `<p-text tag="p | span" size="xx-small | x-small | small | medium" color="contrast-high">`: Body copy.

### 4. Text Inputs Family
- `<p-input-search label="..." placeholder="..." clear="true">`: Search with clear trigger.
- `<p-text-field label="..." placeholder="..." state="none | error" message="...">`: Form text input.
- `<p-textarea label="..." counter="true" max-length="500">`: Multiline text input.
- `<p-select label="...">`: Dropdown menu.
- `<p-multi-select label="...">`: Multi-select dropdown.
- `<p-pin-code length="6" label="...">`: Numeric verification inputs.

### 5. Selection Family
- `<p-checkbox label="..." checked="true | false">`: 48px touch target checkbox.
- `<p-radio-button name="..." value="..." label="...">`: Radio selection.
- `<p-switch label="..." checked="true | false">`: Binary preference toggle.
- `<p-segmented-control value="...">`: Pill segment control.

### 6. Communication & Overlays Family
- `<p-modal open="true | false" dismiss-button="true">`: Frosted dialog modal.
- `<p-flyout open="true | false" position="end">`: Side panel drawer.
- `<p-banner state="info | warning | error" heading="..." description="...">`: Top alert banner.
- `<p-inline-notification state="info | success | warning | error">`: In-context message banner.
- `<p-spinner size="small | medium | large">`: Circular progress spinner.
- `<p-tag color="primary">`: Fuel type, feature tag, or model status pill.
- `<p-tag-dismissible label="...">`: Interactive removable filter chip.

### 7. Brand Heritage Family
- `<p-crest href="/">`: Official coat of arms emblem.
- `<p-wordmark size="small | medium | large" href="/">`: Official PORSCHE typography.
- `<p-model-signature model="911 | taycan | cayenne | panamera | macan | 718">`: Authentic model badge.

---

## 3. Mandatory Executable Constraints (Linter Rules)

| Rule ID | Severity | Constraint Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TDS-RAW-COLOR` | CRITICAL | No raw hex codes (`#010205`), rgb, or hsl strings in styles. Use `var(--p-color-*)`. |
| `TDS-NON-QUANTUM-SPACING` | HIGH | No arbitrary pixel spacing (e.g. `13px`). Use 4px/8px quantum tokens or fluid clamps. |
| `TDS-REINVENTED-COMPONENT` | HIGH | Do not reinvent raw `<button>`, `<input>`, or `<a>`. Import certified `<p-*>` components. |
| `TDS-TOUCH-TARGET-TOO-SMALL` | HIGH | Interactive elements must maintain $\ge 48\times 48\text{px}$ touch targets. |
| `TDS-CAPITALIZATION-NOT-SENTENCE-CASE` | MEDIUM | All button labels, titles, and headers must use sentence case (`Explore all models`). |
| `TDS-CONTRAST-PAIRING` | HIGH | Container background tokens must pair with their corresponding high-contrast foreground color. |
| `TDS-OFFICIAL-BRAND-ASSETS` | HIGH | Never reconstruct Porsche logos or model names as plain text; use `<p-wordmark>` and `<p-model-signature>`. |

---

## 4. Prompt Injection Template for AI Agents
When instructing an agent to build screens for Porsche:

```markdown
You are generating Porsche web user interfaces.
Strictly adhere to the Porsche Design System (PDS v4.5.0) and Trainable DS v1.7.0 rules:
- Reference tokens from `porsche-tokens.css` and `tokens.json`.
- Only use certified `<p-*>` custom elements from `components.json`.
- Enforce sentence case for all labels and CTAs.
- Maintain >= 48px touch targets for all interactive elements.
- Use frosted glass overlays (`blur(32px)` + `--p-color-frosted-*`) for containers.
- Model badges must use `<p-model-signature model="...">`.
```
